title: Eastern Canada 'g5x' reservation bundles: launch orchestration and partner enablement
creator: Liam Brooks
description: Coordinate the launch of the new 'g5x' dedicated instance family and reservation bundles in the Eastern Canada (ca-central-1) region. This ticket covers cross-functional GTM tasks: billing/pricing rollout, partner enablement for resellers and cloud marketplace, release notes sequencing, console UI copy, telemetry dashboards for utilization and SLOs, and legal/billing compliance for local tax/regulatory requirements.
acceptance_criteria: Pricing SKUs for g5x are published in billing and marketplace with correct numeric tiers
Console shows new g5x SKUs and reservation purchase flow in ca-central-1 for eligible accounts
Billing team validated revenue recognition mapping for regional taxes
Partner enablement kit (README, pricing sheet, FAQ) published and shared with VAR partners
Release notes drafted and approved by PM, DevRel, and Legal, and scheduled for publish on 2026-03-25
milestones: 2026-03-03: Finalize pricing tiers and burst capacity rules
2026-03-25: Release notes publish and partner notification
notes: Decision: We will use the existing 'flex-commit' pricing model for g5x but add a 10% introductory discount for first-quarter signups in ca-central-1.
Trade-off: Intro discount accelerates adoption but complicates revenue reporting for Q1. Finance accepted one-time manual reconciliation for March
Risk: Marketplace listing lead time with partner channel may be 7–10 business days; start submission ASAP to avoid GTM delay
Fallback: If marketplace approval misses GA, enable direct purchase in Console with a partner-facing invoicing flow as temporary option
updates: 2026-02-20 Liam Brooks: Created ticket; initial scoping with Billing and Legal. Identified required pricing mapping and marketplace SKU naming convention.
2026-02-25 Ravi Patel: Provided preliminary tier breakpoints for g5x (small/medium/large) and proposed burst policy. Asked PM to confirm reserved vs on-demand differentiation in UI.
2026-03-03 Aisha Nair: Confirmed tiers and introductory 10% discount for Q1. Finance agreed to manual reconciliation for March. Opened BILLING-392 for implementation.
2026-03-07 Marco Ruiz: Drafted partner enablement README and initial FAQ. Requested sample price sheet and one-pager for resellers. Assigned to Sales Eng for review.
2026-03-09 Ellen Cho: Legal approved marketplace terms with minor localization for Canadian consumer protections. Requested final copy for the console buy flow.
2026-03-12 Eng: Completed test purchases in the sandbox for g5x SKUs; discovered metadata mismatch causing UI sort issues. ENG-6342 created for fix.
open_tasks: Finalize marketplace submission package and submit by 2026-03-13
Complete Console QA after ENG-6342 patch (owner: Console Eng)
Share partner kit with top 5 VARs and schedule enablement webinar (owner: Sales Eng)
Publish release notes and schedule email to customers/partners (owner: PM)
Create telemetry dashboard for g5x utilization and reserved vs burst tracking (owner: Observability Eng)
Confirm tax handling for Quebec customers with Finance (owner: Billing)
Prepare rollback plan for SKU if revenue recognition issue not resolved
postmortem_guidelines: If GA is delayed > 3 business days, run a lightweight incident review focusing on blocker root cause and cross-team communication
Track adoption: 7-day and 30-day activation metrics and report to GTM weekly for first month
